title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-07-16

ai_review.summary: Spectacular early‑era performance captured with outstanding archive sound quality
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this early recording, calling the playing "top shelf" and the audio "spectacular" for its age, giving newer fans a vivid window into the Dead’s formative period. The tape is praised as one of the finest examples of archival material despite its unknown source type.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews consistently praise both the musical performance and the audio fidelity, indicating an exceptional show with excellent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as spectacular sound for a 1966 tape; clear, well‑balanced despite age and likely audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific setlist commentary; reviewers focus on overall magic of the early performance.
